title: A professional network for property life in the Dominican Republic
intro: iLoveDR Realty helps property buyers, sellers and owners connect with the people they need to buy, improve, maintain and sell a property. Join our professional network or sign in to explore approved profiles.
join_intro: Lawyers, lenders, tradespeople, property managers and real estate professionals from any company are welcome to apply.
resource_description: Join our property services network, learn how it works or sign in to find approved professionals by service and area.

help_heading: Support through every stage of property ownership
directory_private_heading: Search the directory inside your account
directory_private_description: Professional profiles and business contact details are available to verified, signed-in users. Create an account or sign in, then open DR Professionals in your dashboard. Only approved profiles appear in search.

buy.title: Buy and plan
buy.description: Find property lawyers, surveyors, inspectors, lenders and insurance services for the questions that come with a purchase.

maintain.title: Improve and maintain
maintain.description: Look for builders, designers, electricians, property managers and other services to help care for your property.

professionals.title: Showcase your business
professionals.description: Share your services, business or company name, areas served and chosen business contact details. Real estate agents from other companies can also create a professional profile.

profile.title: Create your account
profile.description: Sign up and verify your email. If you already have an account, sign in to create your professional profile.

services.title: Describe your services
services.description: Choose multiple services and areas, add your business contacts, and optionally upload a photo or logo. Real estate professionals should identify their company or independent business.

review.title: Submit for review
review.description: Save a private draft, confirm permission to share your business details, then submit it. An admin reviews the profile before signed-in members can find it.

directory_auth: Sign in or create an account to search DR Professionals. After email verification, you will continue to the member directory.
